implementation_boundary.reason: The dynamic implementation is an independent private-research implementation of the public objective and validation equations. The public materials do not disclose every production choice, so all output remains explicitly non-equivalent.

legal_ip_gate.source_caveat: Google Patents states that its legal status is an assumption, is not a legal conclusion, and has not been independently analyzed by Google.

disclosed: Static returns-based style analysis estimates average factor exposures from a return history.
Static exposures can conceal changes in investment style and produce misleading averages.
Dynamic analysis is presented as a response to time-varying exposures.
sources.independent_use: Motivates the static baseline, its limitations, and explicit non-equivalence label.
sources.title: Seeing Through Walls: Bringing Greater Transparency to Hedge and Mutual Fund Analysis
unknowns: Production defaults and proprietary dynamic-estimation behavior are not disclosed.

disclosed: A dynamic factor model expresses an asset return as the contemporaneous factor-return vector times time-varying exposures plus residual error.
Flexible least squares balances observation residual error against a penalty on changes in adjacent exposure vectors.
The smoothing parameter is evaluated with leave-one-out cross-validation and Predicted R-squared.
Forward filtering and backward smoothing are described for the time-varying state.
equations: min sum_t (y_t - x_t^T beta_t)^2 + lambda * sum_t ||beta_t - beta_(t-1)||^2
sources.independent_use: Documents the dynamic research target but does not authorize or define the shipped implementation.
sources.title: Dynamic Analysis of Hedge Funds
unknowns: All production constraints, initialization rules, numerical tolerances, and lambda search grids are not disclosed.
Exact current-product equivalence cannot be established from the paper.

disclosed: Candidate factors are grouped hierarchically to reduce redundancy.
Guided factor search compares incremental models and balances parsimony against predictive performance.
sources.independent_use: Requires explicit candidate factor sets and parsimonious time-ordered model selection; proprietary search is excluded.
sources.title: Factor Search Feature Factsheet
unknowns: Clustering distance, branch-pruning thresholds, search order, and tie-breaking defaults are not fully disclosed.

disclosed: A broad economically motivated factor universe is organized into a cluster tree.
Branches are searched and pruned, DSA models are estimated, and candidate models are compared using Predicted R-squared.
sources.independent_use: Supports explicit economic factor families, parsimony, and holdout evidence rather than an opaque universal search.
sources.title: Bridgewater Pure Alpha Case Study
unknowns: The exact factor universe, transformations, pruning heuristics, and production calibrations are not reproducible from the case study.

disclosed: Dynamic exposure estimates are intended to reveal leverage, breakpoints, and changing strategy behavior.
Short histories and cross-validated credibility are highlighted as intended use cases.
sources.independent_use: Defines diagnostic goals and the need for coverage fields; it is not an algorithm specification.
sources.title: MPI for Alternative Investment and Hedge Fund Analysis
unknowns: Marketing descriptions do not establish implementation defaults or statistical guarantees.

disclosed: The current workflow estimates changing exposures, cross-validates factors and parameters, attributes returns, and derives risk and stress diagnostics from public return data.
sources.independent_use: Defines product-level output categories; only transparent static attribution ships in this version.
sources.title: MPI Transparency Lab
unknowns: The public page does not disclose the complete current production pipeline.

disclosed: The index workflow sequences factor selection, cross-validation, dynamic estimation, out-of-sample testing, and tracker construction.
sources.independent_use: Requires strict separation of estimation, holdout validation, and later portfolio use.
sources.title: MPI Hedge Fund Indices
unknowns: Tracker construction and rebalance rules are outside this analytics issue and are not reproduced.

disclosed: Stress analysis can combine historical scenarios, hypothetical factor shocks, reverse tests, and exposure propagation.
sources.independent_use: Reserves stress propagation for a later accepted consumer; this issue emits exposures and contributions only.
sources.title: Portfolio Stress Testing
unknowns: Scenario libraries, shock calibration, and portfolio aggregation defaults are not fully disclosed.

disclosed: A global-macro factor map is evaluated at long and short horizons and interpreted only after Predicted R-squared validation.
sources.independent_use: Requires horizon and factor-set identity to travel with results.
sources.title: Uncovering the Dynamics of Carmignac Patrimoine
unknowns: Horizon defaults and full factor definitions are not generalized from the example.

disclosed: Complex absolute-return strategies may require directional, relative-value, currency, volatility, market, and risk-premia proxies.
sources.independent_use: Supports economically classified, user-approved factors rather than provider-label inference.
sources.title: Standard Life GARS Fund: MPI's Factor X-ray
unknowns: The example does not establish a universal factor taxonomy or selection rule.

disclosed: Returns-based estimates can provide more frequent, comparable effective allocations than delayed holdings snapshots.
sources.independent_use: Factor composition is labeled inferred from returns and never represented as observed holdings.
sources.title: Target-Date Fund Research Series, Part I
unknowns: Returns-based exposure estimates cannot identify individual holdings or eliminate proxy error.

disclosed: A worked attribution separates benchmark-relative factor effects, timing, and residual security-selection effects after model validation.
sources.independent_use: This version reports factor contribution and residual alpha but makes no security-selection or timing claim.
sources.title: Performance Attribution Report: Intrepid Small Cap
unknowns: Security selection cannot be identified from return-only data without additional evidence.

disclosed: Changes in inferred exposures and predictive validity can be monitored as potential strategy-deviation diagnostics.

sources.title: How Proper Analysis of Returns Can Be a Crystal Ball
unknowns: A retrospective case study does not establish prospective detection power.

disclosed: Factor identification, out-of-sample replication, long-short exposure inference, and monitoring are demonstrated for a quantitative fund.
sources.independent_use: Allows negative exposures only in explicitly unconstrained models and requires holdout diagnostics.
sources.title: The Law of Large Numbers: An Analysis of the Renaissance Fund
unknowns: Inferred leverage and long-short exposures remain proxy-dependent estimates.

disclosed: Option-strategy proxies, residual behavior, and poor leave-one-out predictive validity can be used as forensic warning evidence.
sources.independent_use: Requires poor predictive fit and unusual residuals to remain visible rather than tuned away.
sources.title: Madoff Fraud Analysis
unknowns: A return decomposition is not proof of fraud or of a particular hidden strategy.

disclosed: Implausible fit, zero predictive validity, and inconsistent return behavior are presented as forensic warning signs.
sources.independent_use: Negative predictive R-squared is retained as decision-grade evidence rather than floored at zero.
sources.title: Why Would One Invest in an Outlier? An Analysis of the Bayou Fund
unknowns: Forensic flags are diagnostics and do not establish misconduct.

static_equations.excess_return_model: y_t - rf_t = alpha + sum_j beta_j * f_j,t + epsilon_t

dynamic_cleanroom_equations.objective: min sum_t w_t * (y_t - alpha - x_t^T beta_t)^2 + lambda * sum_t ||beta_t - beta_(t-1)||^2 + ridge * sum_t ||beta_t||^2
dynamic_cleanroom_equations.smoothness_selection: maximize training-only leave-one-out Predicted R-squared; choose the largest lambda within the disclosed parsimony tolerance
dynamic_cleanroom_equations.holdout: one-step causal walk-forward prediction uses only the prior filtered state; each holdout observation may update later states but never the selected factor set, lambda, ridge, or training path

dynamic_independent_choices.alpha: one static training intercept; it is not a proprietary dynamic-alpha claim
dynamic_independent_choices.constraints: unconstrained only; proprietary or undisclosed dynamic constraints are not inferred
dynamic_independent_choices.factor_search: factor sets are explicit in the hash-bound specification; no proprietary clustering or branch pruning
dynamic_independent_choices.linear_algebra: deterministic block-tridiagonal solve with disclosed pseudoinverse fallback
dynamic_independent_choices.path_semantics: training states are smoothed within training; holdout states are causal filtered estimates; embargo observations do not update state
dynamic_independent_choices.breakpoints: largest observed exposure changes are diagnostics only; no proprietary breakpoint classifier or local smoothness relaxation
